TaskFlow — Powerful Features for Modern Teams

Prompt

Create a comprehensive features page for a SaaS product:

1. HERO SECTION
- "Powerful Features for Modern Teams"
- Brief intro paragraph
- Two CTAs: "Start Free Trial" and "See Pricing"

2. FEATURE CATEGORIES (tabbed or scrollable sections)

CATEGORY 1: PROJECT MANAGEMENT
- Kanban Boards: Drag-and-drop task management
- Timeline View: Gantt chart for project planning
- Task Dependencies: Link related tasks
- Custom Fields: Add your own data fields
- Include screenshot/mockup for each

CATEGORY 2: TEAM COLLABORATION
- Real-time Editing: Work together simultaneously
- Comments & Mentions: @mention teammates
- File Sharing: Attach documents and images
- Activity Feed: See all team updates

CATEGORY 3: REPORTING & ANALYTICS
- Custom Dashboards: Build your own views
- Time Tracking: Log hours on tasks
- Progress Reports: Automated status updates
- Export Options: PDF, CSV, Excel

CATEGORY 4: INTEGRATIONS
- "Connect with 100+ tools"
- Grid of integration logos (Slack, GitHub, Google, etc.)
- "Don't see your tool? We have an API"

3. USE CASES SECTION
- Marketing Teams
- Software Development
- Creative Agencies
- Remote Teams
Each with specific benefits and mini case study

4. SECURITY SECTION
- SOC 2 Type II certified
- GDPR compliant
- 99.9% uptime SLA
- End-to-end encryption

5. CTA SECTION
- "See TaskFlow in action"
- "Book a personalized demo"

Design: Use icons for each feature, alternating left-right layouts for visual interest.
